Αα.text: This letter is Alpha. It makes the ah sound, like in father. The picture word means star.

Ββ.text: This letter is Vita. It makes the sound at the start of van. The picture word means boat.

Γγ.text: This letter is Gamma. It makes a soft, breathy g sound. The picture word means cat.

Δδ.text: This letter is Delta. It makes the sound at the start of this. The picture word means tree.

Εε.text: This letter is Epsilon. It makes the eh sound, like in egg. The picture word means elephant.

Ζζ.text: This letter is Zita. It makes the sound at the start of zebra. The picture word means zebra.

Ηη.text: This letter is Ita. It makes the ee sound, like in see. The picture word means sun.

Θθ.text: This letter is Thita. It makes the sound at the start of thumb. The picture word means sea.

Ιι.text: This letter is Yota. It makes the ee sound, like in see. The picture word means seahorse.

Κκ.text: This letter is Kappa. It makes the sound at the start of kite. The picture word means hen.

Λλ.text: This letter is Lambda. It makes the sound at the start of lion. The picture word means flower.

Μμ.text: This letter is Mi. It makes the sound at the start of moon. The picture word means apple.

Νν.text: This letter is Ni. It makes the sound at the start of nest. The picture word means water.

Ξξ.text: This letter is Ksi. It makes the sound at the end of fox. The picture word means wood.

Οο.text: This letter is Omikron. It makes the o sound, like in orange. The picture word means umbrella.

Ππ.text: This letter is Pi. It makes the sound at the start of pig. The picture word means duck.

Ρρ.text: This letter is Ro. It makes a rolled r. The picture word means clock.

Σσς.text: This letter is Sigma. It makes the sound at the start of sun. The picture word means dog.

Ττ.text: This letter is Taf. It makes the sound at the start of turtle. The picture word means cheese.

Υυ.text: This letter is Ipsilon. It makes the ee sound, like in see. The picture word means submarine.

Φφ.text: This letter is Fi. It makes the sound at the start of fish. The picture word means moon.

Χχ.text: This letter is Hi. It makes a scratchy h sound, from the back of the throat. The picture word means turtle.

Ψψ.text: This letter is Psi. It makes the sound at the end of cups. The picture word means fish.

Ωω.text: This letter is Omega. It makes the o sound, like in orange. The picture word means ocean.
